verdict.rationale: Airbyte exposes a full REST/config API for connections, syncs, sources/destinations, plus PyAirbyte, Terraform provider, and MCP server access, letting AI-native users automate most workflows without the UI. However, some UI-only features like the Connector Builder's AI Assistant and visual no-code builder are explicitly UI-based, and there's no evidence of a published OpenAPI spec being reachable (probe found 404s) or explicit confirmation that every UI action (e.g., notifications setup, connection timeline browsing) has an API parity. missing for 10: confirmed OpenAPI/schema availability, explicit API parity for Connector Builder/AI Assistant and notification configuration, independent verification that API coverage matches UI feature-for-feature.
